title: GLQuake 0.95 — id Software, Quake on OpenGL
author: id Software
notes: id Software's OpenGL Quake (glquake.exe of 26 August 1997, glq8_27.zip, from id's own FTP), with the shareware episode's data (quake106.zip). The executable as id built it, without the 3dfx miniGL driver that came beside it: MIRAGE-WIN32 makes opengl32.dll in JavaScript and PRISM's gl.js draws its OpenGL 1.1 through WebGL2, the Win32 calls, the sound (DirectSound) and Winsock (no network) answered as for WinQuake.
